entities.name: UPDATE-NEEDED
entities.description: A substate of EMM-REGISTERED where the UE needs to perform tracking area updating but access is barred. Only specific EMM procedures can be initiated in this state.

entities.name: tracking area updating
entities.description: Procedure to update the tracking area information of the UE in the network.

entities.name: combined tracking area updating
entities.description: Combined procedure for tracking area updating along with other functions.

entities.name: service request as a response to paging
entities.description: Service request procedure initiated by the UE in response to network paging.

entities.name: access to current cell barred
entities.description: Condition where UE access to the current cell is barred due to access class control or NAS signalling connection rejection.

relations.description: The UPDATE-NEEDED state is entered when access to the current cell is barred.
Tracking area updating procedure can be initiated in UPDATE-NEEDED state.
Combined tracking area updating procedure can be initiated in UPDATE-NEEDED state.
Service request as response to paging can be initiated in UPDATE-NEEDED state.
